mechanism: Use one original product identity, one stable hand identity and one persistent lighting signature to connect a compact proof sequence. Establish the closed pack and one promise, open the same container to reveal untouched contents, use one tool action to demonstrate material texture, transfer one measured amount onto a clear application surface, and show one complete spread result. Let each stage answer exactly one new product question and place any short text only after the supporting action becomes visible. Return to the complete closed pack in the same light for a restrained name-and-benefit lockup. The reusable mechanism is product identity, reveal, texture proof, measured use, application result and final benefit closure—not the source jar, label, hands, cream, spatula, wall, leaf shadow, exact copy, layout, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish one closed original product, one hand identity and one lighting signature.
invariants.purpose: Creates a trustworthy baseline across macro scale changes.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing pack or hands weakens product continuity.

invariants.rule: Open the same container and reveal untouched contents before manipulation.
invariants.purpose: Answers what is inside before making performance claims.
invariants.ablation_failure: Beginning with a scoop removes packaging-to-material proof.

invariants.rule: Use one tool action to show material response and a single measured quantity.
Transfer the measured amount to one application surface and show the complete spread.
invariants.purpose: Connects material proof to actual use.
invariants.ablation_failure: A beauty close-up without application is unsupported.

invariants.rule: Return to the complete closed pack and add only concise text supported by prior stages.
invariants.purpose: Consolidates evidence into a usable product message.
invariants.ablation_failure: New claims at the end break the proof chain.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.
